purpose: Blind independent retrieval comparison of frozen R0 and R5
baseline_policy: New synthetic project baselines, not the clinic/commerce/SaaS baselines used for R5 development.
label_policy: Every independently affected frozen baseline requirement is a target. Zero targets mean no material baseline relationship. Ambiguous targets are flagged for adjudication and excluded from strong claims until resolved.
provenance_policy: Record MODEL_GENERATED and SYNTHETIC accurately for agent-authored drafts. No claim of human-written examples or independent human labels until reviewer evidence exists.
review_policy: Human reviewer adjudicates each expected target set without R0/R5 predictions. Retain original proposal and reviewer decision. Freeze dataset bytes and hash only after review.
contamination_policy: Audit exact and normalized duplicate messages, requirement text, and pairs against all development, historical, and closed-final corpora; manually review nearest semantic overlaps. Original LoRA training overlap remains UNKNOWN.
evaluation_policy: No R0/R5 run until labels, contamination decisions, hash, and gate are frozen. Use exact same bytes and production scorer on both configurations. Preserve both reports and per-case ledger; never edit labels after results.
end_to_end_plan: If R5 generalisation is supported, define and review a separate protected 24-case six-label end-to-end set before V3 execution. A reviewer must approve pair labels and expected affected requirement IDs before model output is observed.
